description_en: Retrieves the list of system configurations
kebab_example: aliyun outboundbot list-system-configs --object-type INSTANCE --object-id 4f9a8e2b-6c1d-4a7e-9b3f-2d5c8a1e7b04 --name callableTime --api-version 2025-11-11 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListSystemConfigs

parameters.help_en:
The configuration type.\
INSTANCE: instance-level.\
TENANT: tenant-level
parameters.help_zh:
配置类型\
INSTANCE：表示实例级\
TENANT：表示租户级
parameters.name: object_type

parameters.help_en:
The configuration type ID.\
If ObjectType is set to INSTANCE, this parameter specifies the instance ID.\
If ObjectType is set to TENANT, this parameter specifies the tenant ID
parameters.help_zh:
配置类型ID\
ObjectType=INSTANCE时，表示实例ID\
ObjectType=TENANT时，表示租户ID
parameters.name: object_id

parameters.help_en:
The system configuration name.\
callableTime: the outbound job window.\
calleeDailyAttemptLimit: the maximum number of daily calls to a single callee number
parameters.help_zh:
系统配置名称\
callableTime：外呼作业窗口\
calleeDailyAttemptLimit：单个被叫号码每日呼叫上限
parameters.name: name
